thread:
Ana: Quick heads-up — I need coverage for EU morning oncall this Saturday (2026-03-21) 08:00–16:00 UTC. Family thing. Leaving a short handoff and a couple of checks below.

Ana: Handoff notes:
- Primary services to watch: inference-api (public), model-serving-pool-eu, akamai-edge.
- Known risk: friday-night model rollout (redwood-13b-q4f -> redwood-13b-q4f-v2) hits 23:30 UTC — can increase tail latency briefly. If you see latency >500ms, route to `redwood-13b-std`.
- Prewarm: run `./scripts/prewarm --model redwood-13b-q4f-v2 --context 1024 --region eu` at 07:45 UTC. That warms KV caches for common prefixes.
- Quick health checks: `curl -s https://api.redwood-int/internal/health | jq .` should show all green, and `redis-cli -h cache-eu info keyspace` should return non-empty DB.
- Escalation: ping oncall-incident if you hit sustained 5xx > 3m or error budget burn > 10%.

Laura: I can cover 08:00–12:00 UTC. I’ll do the 07:45 prewarm and watch the rollout during my window. Leaving my calendar blocked.

Mike: I can pick up 12:00–16:00 UTC. @Laura please drop any quick notes for the handoff around 11:50.

Ravi: FYI — check KMS access token expiry for the dedicated pool. I rotated a key last week but the old token might still be cached in a few nodes; if you see auth errors to keymanager, run `kubectl -n infra restart deploy/key-manager-proxy`.

Laura: Thanks — noted. Also adding a tiny checklist I'll paste into the handoff message at 11:45: 
- Verify model route health in Console > Models > redwood-13b-q4f-v2
- Confirm edge error rate <0.5%
- Validate token consumption isn't spiking (Console > Billing > Token usage last 1h)

Mike: Cool. One more thing — there's a planned infra maintenance window Sat 10:30–10:45 UTC for the EU infra team (non-disruptive but node reboots possible). If anything degrades during that 15m, don't escalate immediately — wait 7 minutes, if still failing then open a ticket and we escalate. I'm adding the maintenance note to the oncall calendar.

Oncall Bot: Schedule updated: Laura assigned 3864219000.1 (08:00-12:00 UTC), Mike assigned 3864219000.2 (12:00-16:00 UTC).

Ana: Thanks all — leaving a quick pair of snippets for route switch if needed: 
- Switch to backup route via Console CLI: `rwctl route set --route inference-api --model redwood-13b-std --reason "rollout latency"`
- Temporary mute alerts while you investigate: `alerts mute --team eng-oncall --ttl 30m --reason "manual investigation"`

Laura: I'll send the 11:50 handoff with the checklist and paste any live observations.

Mike: Got it. If either of you notices the model rollout failing validation tests in staging, DM me — I can flip the canary policy from 10% -> 0% quickly.

Ana: You're the best, thanks. Leaving Slack notifications on and my emergency contact in case anything unexpected pops up. :pray:

Laura: All set on my side. See you on the handoff. :wave:

Mike: Ready to take the second half. Good luck and enjoy the weekend, Ana! :thumbsup:
